verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.literal: Then Bildad the Shuhite . . . replied

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֤נָה׀ תְּשִׂימ֣וּן קִנְצֵ֣י לְמִלִּ֑ין תָּ֝בִ֗ינוּ וְאַחַ֥ר נְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh tə·śî·mūn qin·ṣê lə·mil·lîn tā·ḇî·nū wə·’a·ḥar nə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: How long until you end . . . these speeches Show some sense and then we can talk

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁ֣בְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נִ֝טְמִ֗ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: Why are we regarded as cattle as stupid in your sight

verses.original: טֹֽרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֗וֹ בְּאַ֫פּ֥וֹ הַ֭לְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָ֣זַב אָ֑רֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק־ צ֝֗וּר מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·rêp̄ nap̄·šōw bə·’ap·pōw hal·ma·‘an·ḵā tê·‘ā·zaḇ ’ā·reṣ wə·ye‘·taq- ṣūr mim·mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: You who tear yourself in anger should the earth be forsaken on your account or the rocks be moved from their place

verses.original: גַּ֤ם א֣וֹר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ יִ֝גַּ֗הּ שְׁבִ֣יב אִשּֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: gam ’ō·wr rə·šā·‘îm yiḏ·‘āḵ wə·lō- yig·gah šə·ḇîḇ ’iš·šōw
verses.literal: Indeed the lamp of the wicked is extinguished the flame of his fire does not glow

verses.original: א֭וֹר חָשַׁ֣ךְ בְּאָהֳל֑וֹ וְ֝נֵר֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.literal: The light in his tent grows dark and the lamp beside him goes out

verses.original: יֵֽ֭צְרוּ צַעֲדֵ֣י אוֹנ֑וֹ וְֽתַשְׁלִיכֵ֥הוּ עֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: His vigorous stride is shortened and his own schemes trip him up

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּרֶ֣שֶׁת בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וְעַל־ שְׂ֝בָכָ֗ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šul·laḥ bə·re·šeṯ bə·raḡ·lāw wə·‘a·lś- śə·b̲ā·k̲āh yiṯ·hal·lāḵ
verses.literal: For his own feet lead him into a net and he wanders into its mesh

verses.original: יֹאחֵ֣ז בְּעָקֵ֣ב פָּ֑ח יַחֲזֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו צַמִּֽים׃
verses.literal: A trap seizes his heel a snare grips him . . .

verses.original: טָמ֣וּן בָּאָ֣רֶץ חַבְל֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכֻּדְתּ֗וֹ עֲלֵ֣י נָתִֽיב׃
verses.literal: A noose is hidden in the ground and a trap lies in his path

verses.original: סָ֭בִיב בִּֽעֲתֻ֣הוּ בַלָּה֑וֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻ֥הוּ לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.literal: Terrors frighten him on every side and harass his every step

verses.original: יְהִי־ רָעֵ֥ב אֹנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֵ֗יד נָכ֥וֹן לְצַלְעֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: His strength is depleted and calamity is ready at his side

verses.original: יֹ֭אכַל בַּדֵּ֣י עוֹר֑וֹ יֹאכַ֥ל בַּ֝דָּ֗יו בְּכ֣וֹר מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: yō·ḵal bad·dê ‘ō·w·rōw yō·ḵal bad·dāw bə·ḵō·wr mā·weṯ
verses.literal: It devours patches of his skin the firstborn of death devours his limbs

verses.original: יִנָּתֵ֣ק מֵ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְ֝תַצְעִדֵ֗הוּ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: yin·nā·ṯêq mê·’ā·ho·lōw miḇ·ṭa·ḥōw wə·ṯaṣ·‘i·ḏê·hū lə·me·leḵ bal·lā·hō·wṯ
verses.literal: He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors

verses.original: תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן בְּ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִי־ ל֑וֹ יְזֹרֶ֖ה עַל־ נָוֵ֣הוּ גָפְרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: tiš·kō·wn bə·’ā·ho·lōw mib·bə·lî- lōw yə·zō·reh ‘al- nā·wê·hū ḡā·p̄ə·rîṯ
verses.literal: Fire resides in his tent burning sulfur rains down on his dwelling

verses.original: מִ֭תַּחַת שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יִבָ֑שׁוּ וּ֝מִמַּ֗עַל יִמַּ֥ל קְצִירֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mit·ta·ḥaṯ šā·rā·šāw yi·ḇā·šū ū·mim·ma·‘al yim·mal qə·ṣî·rōw
verses.literal: The roots beneath him dry up and the branches above him wither away

verses.original: זִֽכְרוֹ־ אָ֭בַד מִנִּי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־ שֵׁ֥ם ל֝֗וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ חֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rōw- ’ā·ḇaḏ min·nî- ’ā·reṣ wə·lō- šêm lōw ‘al- pə·nê- ḥūṣ
verses.literal: The memory of him perishes from the earth and he has no name in the land

verses.original: יֶ֭הְדְּפֻהוּ מֵא֣וֹר אֶל־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּֽמִתֵּבֵ֥ל יְנִדֻּֽהוּ׃
verses.literal: He is driven from light into darkness and is chased from the inhabited world

verses.original: לֹ֘א נִ֤ין ל֣וֹ וְלֹא־ נֶ֣כֶד בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין שָׂ֝רִ֗יד בִּמְגוּרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lō nîn lōw wə·lō- ne·ḵeḏ bə·‘am·mōw wə·’ên śā·rîd̲ bim·ḡū·rāw
verses.literal: He has no offspring or posterity among his people no survivor where he once lived

verses.original: עַל־ י֭וֹמוֹ נָשַׁ֣מּוּ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים וְ֝קַדְמֹנִ֗ים אָ֣חֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר׃
verses.literal: Those in the west are appalled at his fate while those in the east . . . tremble in horror

verses.original: אַךְ־ אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁכְּנ֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝זֶ֗ה מְק֣וֹם לֹא־ יָדַֽע־ אֵֽל׃ס
verses.literal: Surely such is the dwelling of the wicked and the place of one who does not know God
